items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: Ruth was interviewed in Clinton, NY on April 2, 2013, by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Ruth was interviewed in Clinton, NY on April 2, 2013, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Her husband, Milt Robinson, participated briefly in the interview.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive today with Ruth Brisbane. Welcome to Hamilton.
